mentl/586083d:
Type system: Type::Record added to unify(), apply_subst(), occurs_in().
Two closed records unify if fields match by name. Open records (with
rest row variable) support row polymorphism — excess fields constrain
the row variable:

  fn get_x(p) = p.x           // infers: p has at least { x: a }
  get_x({ x: 42, y: 99 })     // works — extra field y accepted
  get_x({ x: 7 })             // works — exact match

Sorted merge join algorithm for field unification handles arbitrary
field sets in O(n+m). Row variables bind to excess fields, enabling
structural subtyping without explicit type annotations.

This completes the record type system: structural types + inference +
unification + row polymorphism + self-describing runtime access.
sonido/586f5ac:
The main content area (INPUT | CHAIN | OUTPUT) was invisible because
egui's vertical_centered() inside horizontal() greedily consumes all
available width — a known egui layout limitation (#2815). Only the INPUT
column rendered; the effect chain strip and output section were pushed
off-screen.

Replace with manual rect splitting using ui.new_child(UiBuilder) to
create bounded child UIs for each column: fixed-width I/O columns
(100px) flanking a flexible center column. This is the same pattern egui
uses internally for columns_const. Also removes redundant ui.vertical()
wrappers from render_io_section and render_output_section since the
parent now constrains width and sets centered layout.
